disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV / DSM-5 autism spectrum disorder; replication clinical cohort from ABIDE I and II. NM trained on LEAP NT subjects was applied to this independent sample to assess replicability.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "To assess replicability, we selected a sample from the publicly available Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and II ... This resulted in a sample of 418 males with autism, 95 females with autism, 473 neurotypical males and 218 neurotypical females."
